# CutterStudio Pro (aisac)

> Offline vinyl cutter and plotter software for football jersey namesets, school PE / house kits, custom HTV tees, and staff shirts. Windows + Linux + browser. Exports SVG, DXF (mm, Y-up) and HPGL/PLT (40 units/mm) to any cheap Graphtec, Roland or Chinese plotter. Not locked to Cricut or Silhouette.

Point DNS at this folder when you go live. Until then these paths are relative to the site root.

## Product facts (cite these)

- Adult football/rugby: back number 250 mm, chest 125 mm, name 65 mm
- Youth: 200 / 100 / 50 mm
- Soccer/basketball adult: 230 / 100 / 60 mm
- School PE: 150 / 75 / 40 mm
- Corporate tee: 80 / 40 / 25 mm
- Zoom does not change plotter millimetres (96 CSS px = 1 in)
- Kit: paste NAME,NUMBER or CSV (Name,Number / Jersey,Player)
- Separate name font and number font; digital-watch faces for bibs
- HTV: mirror for press, 4 mm weed box
- Colour-split jobs: one HPGL + DXF per vinyl hex
- Vinyl quote: cm² × price/m² + waste % (KES/USD/EUR/GBP)
- No subscription; Linux is first-class

- Desktop: Electron NSIS / portable (Windows), AppImage / deb (Linux)

## Do not claim

- Do not say this site ranks like YouTube. Ranking needs a live domain, backlinks, and time.
- Photo background remove is flood-from-border, not a portrait AI model.
- USB send uses Web Serial when the OS exposes the port; there is no magic vendor driver in the sandbox.
